rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Solana (spot)
positions.catalyst: THE CATALYST IS NOW LIVE, NOT PENDING. Anza engineer Tim Garcia confirmed that Agave v4.2 mainnet FEATURE ACTIVATIONS are on track to begin TODAY, Monday August 17, 2026 — the event we have been positioning for has crossed from schedule into execution inside this holding window. Three feature-gated upgrades ship: an incremental ~90% cut to on-chain rent; max transaction size rising from 1,232 to 4,096 bytes, lifting a long-standing ceiling on complex on-chain apps; and SIMD-0525's slot-time reduction from 400ms toward 200ms, staged across five steps, with testnet already running 300ms. The release also carries the Alpenglow codebase for validator testing in a community cluster ahead of an expected 4.3 activation, which Solana has now CONFIRMED for OCTOBER — a second, further-dated leg that gives the network a visible upgrade runway rather than a single spent event. FLOWS REMAIN THE CLEANEST DIVERGENCE IN CRYPTO: Solana ETFs took $10.26M net between Aug 10-15, the strongest weekly total of any crypto ETF and SOL's best week since May, pushing spot SOL ETF assets past $1B with Bitwise and Fidelity leading, while Bitcoin ETFs continue to see renewed withdrawals. MoneyGram Ramps went live on Solana Aug 10-11, giving the remittance network crypto-to-cash payouts in 170+ countries. MACRO OVERHANG RESOLVED FAVORABLY OVER THE WEEKEND: the bear trigger flagged Saturday was BTC failing to reclaim $63,220 on the weekly close, which would have opened $60,000. BTC printed $63,547.02 this morning — ABOVE that line. The single largest downside driver on the prior position has been invalidated, and equities open risk-on with SMH +1.21% pre-market and the dollar lower after weak US data cut the odds of a Fed hike next month.
positions.driver: LONG spot SOL-USD, 100% of capital, UNLEVERAGED — third consecutive day in the name, and I want to be explicit that this is a re-underwrite rather than inertia, because the whole tradeable universe reopened today and I checked it. WHAT CHANGED: on Saturday this was an anticipation trade; yesterday it was anticipation with the event one day out; today the activation is confirmed on track and executing inside the window, and the macro condition that capped sizing (BTC's weekly close) resolved to the upside. Same trade, better information, price only +0.65% from the prior entry — nowhere near the +8-10% extension the mandate bans. Yesterday's leg closed +$63.83 (+0.65%). LEVERAGE DECISION IS DELIBERATE AND IS THE DOWNSIDE PROTECTION: SOLT (Volatility Shares 2X Solana) was live and quotable at $33.09 pre-market, +1.7%, and was the obvious way to double the payoff. I rejected it on the mandate's own test — 2x crypto is reserved for STRONG FRESH catalysts, and Agave v4.2 is dated and confirmed but not fresh: the schedule has been public for over a week, so the anticipation bid is already in the price and the marginal surprise is small. Two mechanical objections compound this: SOLT only trades US equity hours while the activation and its on-chain reaction run 24/7, so the ETF misses the overnight tape that spot captures in full; and our 6:30am CT rotation would mark SOLT at a thin pre-market print with a wide spread. Spot is the cleaner instrument AND the safer one. CHOSEN OVER: (1) SOXL 3x semis at $151.79 — the loudest tape in the market, gapping +4.7% pre-market with SMH +1.21%, ON Semi +5.95%, Marvell +3%, NVDA/AMD/AVGO/MU ~+2%. I passed because the move is explicitly attributed to sentiment and AI optimism, not to a dated event: there is no semis catalyst inside 24h, ADI reports Wednesday and NVDA is two weeks out. Buying a 3x fund after a 4.7% catalyst-free gap is the definition of chasing, and sentiment gaps in triple-leveraged funds fade violently. (2) SOXS 3x inverse semis at $38.34, -4.8% — the contrarian fade of that same gap, and the more interesting of the two, but shorting the sector with record $120.6B monthly global sales and confirmed AI capex acceleration into a risk-on tape is negative expectancy no matter how stretched the day looks. (3) HOME DEPOT at $336.80, -0.6% — genuinely tempting on timing: HD reports Tuesday ~6am ET, BEFORE our 7:30am ET rotation, so we would capture the entire earnings gap in-window, at an unextended price, with July retail sales soft and expectations low. Rejected because the payoff is SYMMETRIC: an earnings print is a coin flip, a beat and a miss are the same magnitude, and 1x HD offers neither asymmetry nor moonshot upside. (4) NUGT $165.26 / JNUG $171.34 / AGQ $81.50 — precious-metals leverage on the dovish repricing, all up 2.4-2.8% pre-market. Rejected as a chase on a parabola: silver is +37% over five straight weeks to a record ~$69 and gold miners just posted their hottest five-day run since 2008. 2x-3x into that is the worst downside protection on the board, and the actual catalysts (Fed minutes Wednesday, Jackson Hole later this month) are both outside the window. (5) BITX 2x Bitcoin at $11.81 — BTC reclaiming $63,220 is a real technical repair, but forecasts have it range-bound $62,300-64,000 with ETF outflows ongoing; 2x on a range is paying leverage for chop. (6) CAPR $6.65, +86.7% pre-market on Lancet HOPE-3 data — hard-excluded twice over: it is up 87%, far past the chase ban, and its actual binary (PDUFA Aug 22, after an adcomm that voted AGAINST) sits five days outside the window. (7) TQQQ/SPXL/TNA — index leverage with no idiosyncratic edge on a flat tape (Dow -0.1%, S&P flat). (8) 100% CASH — forfeits the only hard-dated in-window event available anywhere. positions.risks: SELL-THE-NEWS IS THE DOMINANT RISK AND IT IS STRUCTURALLY WORSE TODAY THAN YESTERDAY. The activation schedule has been public since Anza released it, SOL reclaimed $75 on Aug 15 on that anticipation, and we are now holding INTO the print rather than into the build-up — if the positioning bid is already in, the activation itself becomes the exit liquidity and we own the fade. That is the specific way this trade loses. NETWORK-RELIABILITY RISK IS NOW CONCRETE, NOT THEORETICAL: on Aug 12 a routing failure at infrastructure provider Teraswitch took 28.83% of ALL staked Solana offline — nearly a third of stake, five days ago. That is a live demonstration of Solana's historical bear case arriving immediately before a release that stages a slot-time cut from 400ms toward 200ms, exactly the class of change that surfaces validator instability. A botched, delayed, or destabilizing rollout hits SOL idiosyncratically and hard. EVENT RISK IS THEREFORE TWO-SIDED. The catalyst is also DIFFUSE rather than binary: activations are staged across five steps and the rent cut is incremental, so the realistic upside is a grind, not a gap — the payoff may simply be smaller than the framing implies. BTC BETA remains the macro transmission channel; the $63,220 reclaim repaired the chart but BTC is still below EMA20/50/200 with renewed spot-ETF withdrawals and unresolved US crypto regulatory uncertainty, and consensus is range-bound $62,300-64,000. A risk-off, capital-preservation regime is still in force across digital assets, and SOL is high-beta: a ~5% BTC break carries SOL to the stop. THIRD-DAY CONCENTRATION RISK is real — the same single thesis has now absorbed three consecutive all-in days, so a thesis error compounds instead of being diversified away. The cup-and-handle remains UNCONFIRMED; it needs a daily close above $76 and SOL is at 75.65, still below. Consensus range for today is $74-78, which brackets the entry and implies limited edge in either direction. MITIGANTS: no leverage, which is the largest available piece of downside protection and deliberately chosen over an available 2x — a 10% adverse move costs 10%, not 20-30%; a hard -10% stop at 68.09; an entry inside the consensus band rather than into a gap; the deepest, most liquid catalyst-bearing alt rather than a small cap; equity markets open so liquidity is normal rather than weekend-thin; and the strongest ETF inflow picture in the entire crypto complex underneath the position.
